g.text: Libo: forward displacement and observed contact loss
A = mean of missing feet / expected flat feet at valid 10 ms snapshots; expected=0 snapshots omitted.
0–6 s; identical retained trials. Pale bars: sample SD. Single flat control per wave; uniform circle markers.
